stress.gate_oxide_citation: GF180MCU design rule manual 14.1.4.2: 3.63 V maximum DC between the gate and any other FET node (3.3 V devices); the gate-node voltage may periodically exceed the DC maximum depending on duty cycle (TDDB).
stress.allowance_is_ours: The manual publishes no numbers for that allowance. The bounds below are this flow's own, chosen on principle and not fitted to any macro.
stress.junction_citation: The GF180MCU design rule manual gives no number for a drain, source or body junction: 14.1.4.2 covers the gate only, and 14.1.4.1 (hot carriers, drain-source) asks that the supply stay within 10% over Vdd for any significant time, with no number. The limit here is the minimum BVDSS of the PDK electrical specification, 3.3 V devices, W/L 10/0.28.
